per_case_findings.finding: Re-authored as a distinct numeric ParseLevel boundary task. The parser accepts -128 through 127; the out-of-range test expects an error and NoLevel.
Verified UpdateContext is the mutating callback API and its comments warn it is not concurrency safe, recommending a child logger for concurrent updates.
Verified MsgFunc returns immediately for a nil Event; the cited test now includes the callback flag and nil-receiver invocation.
Verified LevelWriter embeds io.Writer and adds WriteLevel(level, payload).
Verified positive poll interval selects Poller with interval/context options; zero or negative selects Waiter.
Verified empty, digit-leading, and underscore-leading normalized journald keys are prefixed with X; the cited test includes empty and digit cases.
Verified CreateArray copies stack, context, and hooks from the context logger.
Verified the enum ordering and explicit TraceLevel=-1 from the complete cited constant block.
Verified the API comment requires Msg to send the event; Msg also nil-guards its receiver.

Verified N=0 rejects, N=1 passes, and N>1 passes calls where the atomically incremented counter modulo N equals 1.
Verified the BurstSampler contract and code: after the burst it delegates to NextSampler, and returns false when none is configured.
